name: TitlePremium
prompt: Design a premium finished GAME TITLE EMBLEM texture, exact words GRAVITY FRONTLINE in two stacked lines, impeccable readable custom letterforms. The brand is an immersive first-person gravity combat game in a monumental clockwork boulevard. A distinctive 3D machined gunmetal gravitational gyroscope behind and embracing the typography, nested physically credible thin orbit rings, a small brilliant cyan singularity at the upper centre, fine engraved bronze calibrations, subtle brushed titanium surfaces and high-end product photography lighting. Typography is heavy sculpted brushed pale silver with precision bevels, restrained inner blue emission, intelligent ligatures unique to GRAVITY FRONTLINE. Sophisticated brutalist science fiction title treatment, genuinely crafted hardware identity. Warm aged bronze accents tie into a clock tower, restrained cyan and violet optical energy. Strong hierarchy, 60 percent type and 40 percent emblem, wide compact composition, not a generic esports logo, not a flat font, not a blank rectangle or UI wireframe. All letters must be correctly spelled and fully readable. No extra text, no subtitle. Entire emblem isolated on pure solid BLACK background, bounded in central 85% width and 75% height, generous margin to crop, no vignette border, no characters, no landscape. Orthographic front view with shallow material depth, clean silhouette. This is one separate title block to combine with a cinematic image and two independent buttons.

name: ButtonsPremium
prompt: Create a PRODUCTION GAME BUTTON SPRITE SHEET: two separate large horizontal controls stacked vertically on pure solid black background. Top button reads exactly START GAME. Bottom button reads exactly EXIT GAME. Upper button contained between 12% and 44% of image height; lower between 56% and 88%. Both around 84% of canvas width. Each is a designed tangible spacecraft control with layered machined gunmetal housing, precisely beveled asymmetric corners, sculpted brushed titanium outer edges, finely engraved seams, small copper fasteners and captivating inner cyan optics. Top START GAME is the hero control: substantial luminous cyan inlay, crisp large bone-white bespoke angular lettering, beautiful triangular play icon inside a small gravitational ring on its left, a short segmented activation strip at the right edge. Lower EXIT GAME is visually quieter: smoked slate inner surface, restrained bronze rim, clear silver lettering and an elegant power icon on the left. Editorial precision and expensive material quality; rich but controlled detail, no busy greebles behind text, no flat rectangles, no thin wireframe rectangles, no ordinary web buttons. The exact English labels are part of the art. No other text, no digits, no background scene, no watermark. Front-facing flat UI camera with realistic shallow relief, no perspective skew. Empty solid black gutters around and between the independently reusable button sprites.

name: BackgroundNatural
prompt: A single seamless full-bleed cinematic environment background for a premium immersive gravity action game. Wide 16:9 composition across the ENTIRE image, naturally continuous atmospheric world, never a framed picture, no panels. Human eye-level view along a beautifully convincing old European clocktower boulevard at blue hour after rain. The clocktower is in the right third at a believable distance, elegant warm amber streetlamps, aged limestone facades, subtle copper clockwork details, wet cobblestones with soft physically plausible reflections, nuanced cool slate blue air and warm lights, drifting fine fog. On the right half, a restrained gravitational distortion lifts a few pavement stones in gently curving trajectories, delicate diffuse cyan and violet light scattered through the mist, NO giant portal ring, NO laser web, NO obvious circular sci-fi gateway. Elegant art direction, organic lighting, tactile architecture and convincing spatial scale, sophisticated narrative atmosphere rather than a glossy generic sci-fi wallpaper. The left 43 percent is naturally darker and visually quiet: shadowed foreground building frontage and soft fog, still coherent with the SAME street and vanishing point, suitable negative space for separately overlaid title and menu buttons. The bottom left remains dark and quiet. Detail and warm visual interest concentrate in the right two thirds, with gradual organic contrast transitions, absolutely no abrupt rectangular edges or inset picture. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no buttons, no watermark. A cinematic environment matte painting with photoreal materials, subtle film grain and natural light, beautifully restrained.
